augments.name: All For You
augments.description: Your heals and shields on allied champions are increased in effectiveness by 30%.
augments.shortDescription: Your Heals and Shields are stronger when used on an ally.

augments.name: Apex Inventor
augments.description: Grants 100 item haste, which is equivalent to 50% cooldown reduction for items.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 100 Item Haste (equivalent to 50% Item CDR). Item Haste reduces the cooldown of all Item Abilities.

augments.name: Big Brain
augments.description: Gain a shield that absorbs damage equal to 300% AP and lasts until destroyed. Shield is replenished upon respawn and every 70 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 3 Shield for every 1 Ability Power. Resets on death or 70 seconds after depletion.

augments.name: Bread And Butter
augments.description: Your champion's first basic ability (Q) gains 100 ability haste.
augments.shortDescription: Your Q ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

augments.name: Bread And Cheese
augments.description: Your champion's third basic ability (E) gains 100 ability haste.
augments.shortDescription: Your E ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

augments.name: Bread And Jam
augments.description: Your champion's second basic ability (W) gains 100 ability haste.
augments.shortDescription: Your W ability gains 100 Ability Haste.

augments.name: Celestial Body
augments.description: Gain 1500 bonus health, but reduce your damage output by 10%.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 1500 Health, but you deal 10% less damage.

augments.name: Chain Reaction
augments.description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a knock back effect, empowering the ability to trigger a chain reaction effect when displaced champions hit other champions or terrain within 200 units. If a knocked back champion collides with another enemy champion during their displacement, the champions they collided with are dealt  and knocked up for 0.5 seconds. If they collide with terrain during their displacement, they will rebound to take  and become knocked up for 0.75 seconds and stunned for 0.5 seconds. The knock up duration is increased to up to 1.1 seconds based on how long the ability's cooldown is.
If the upgraded ability is an ultimate, this effect deals 250% damage, increasing the champion collision damage to {{pp|100*2.5 to 400*2.5|150*2.5 to 800*2.5.
augments.shortDescription: If a target knocked back by your ability hits another champion, they are knocked up and dealt damage. When colliding with terrain, the knock up duration is extended and they are dealt bonus damage.

augments.name: Combusting Interest
augments.description: Gain {{pp|1 to 3 (+ 0.75% of damage dealt) gold}} for each tick of damage dealt to enemy champions with damage over time effects.
augments.shortDescription: Burn and damage-over-time on champions generate gold.

augments.name: Critical Healing
augments.description: Your heals and shields now have a chance equal to your critical strike chance|critical strike chance to increase in effectiveness by 40% (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.shortDescription: Your healing and Shields can Critically Strike for 40% bonus amount. Gain 25% Crit Chance.

augments.name: Critical Missile
augments.description: Critical strikes against enemy champions launch 1 (+ 1 per 50% critical strike chance) missiles at the target that each deal magic damage magic damage. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.shortDescription: When you Critically Strike, fire missiles dealing magic damage. Gain 25% Crit chance.

augments.name: Critical Rhythm
augments.description: Your critical strikes grant you 6% bonus attack speed for 6 seconds, stacking up to 10 times for a total of 60%. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.shortDescription: Your basic Attack stacks Attack Speed on Critical Strikes. Gain 25% Crit chance.

augments.name: Dawnbringer's Resolve
augments.description: Upon dropping below 50% maximum health, you are healed for30% of your maximum health|{{ap% of your maximum health every 0.25 seconds}}over 3 seconds (45 second cooldown, reset upon death).
augments.shortDescription: When dropping below 50% Health, heal for 30% max Health over 3 seconds. Resets on death or every 45 seconds.

augments.name: Divine Intervention
augments.description: Automatically cast Cosmic Radiance|Taric, calling down a protective star upon you that descends over 2.5 seconds. Afterwards, you and all allied champions within cr| 400 units become invulnerable for 2.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).
augments.shortDescription: Every 35 seconds, Autocast a protective star. Upon its landing, you and nearby allies become Invulnerable for a few seconds.

augments.name: Donation
augments.description: Gain 1750 upon acquiring this augment.
augments.shortDescription: Get 1750 Gold. No questions asked.

augments.name: Endless Decimation
augments.description: While in combat, automatically cast an improved version of Q|Darius, winding up over 1.25 seconds to slash in a cr| 460 radius around you. The slash deals physical damage (+ 60% AD) (+ 40% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown). Enemies within the cr| 240 inner radius of the slash take50% damage.|{{pp|physical damage (+  (+  physical damage.}}Additionally, for each enemy champion hit along the outer edge, you heal for 18% of your missing health and the cooldown of this effect is reduced by 10%, down to a minimum of 3 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: While in combat, Autocast a circular axe that deals physical damage. Enemies on the outer edge take additional damage and heal you.

augments.name: Ethereal Weapon
augments.description: Your abilities apply on hit effects (1 second cooldown per target).
augments.shortDescription: Your Abilities apply On-Hit effects. 1 second Cooldown per target.

augments.name: Final City Transit
augments.description:
Upon death, you summon a train over 1 second that launches towards your killer at full speed, travelling in their direction at a global distance and dealing physical damage (+ 65% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP) (+ 15% maximum health) physical damage to enemies it passes through.
The train is summoned a slight distance away from the front of your killer, based on their facing direction at the time of your death, and launches towards the position they were located at the time of your death.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: When you die, launch a train towards your killer, dealing physical damage to enemies it hits. The train does not stop.

augments.name: Firebrand
augments.description: Basic attacks apply a Burn for 5 seconds that deals bonus magic damage equal to{{ap% of the target's maximum health per second.|2% of the target's maximum health over the duration.}}This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.
augments.shortDescription: Your Attacks apply an infinitely stacking Burn On-Hit, dealing damage over time.

augments.name: Flashy
augments.description:
Your Flash now has 3 charges with a 2-second cooldown|1.18 seconds after applying the 70 summoner spell haste from the global ARAM champion buff between casts (120 seconds recharge time for all 3 charges).
If Flash is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Flash.
augments.shortDescription: Your Flash has 3 charges. After 120 seconds, regain all charges.

augments.name: From Beginning to End
augments.description: Gain the Dark Harvest and First Strike keystone runes.
augments.shortDescription: Gain the First Strike and Dark Harvest Keystone Runes.

augments.name: From Downtown
augments.description:
Quest: Hit enemy champions with abilities while located at least er| 600 units away from them (at the time of the hit) 15 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, hitting enemy champions with abilities while located at least er| 600 units away from them at the time of the hit fires a meteor to their current location, which upon landing deals 75 to 200|(+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies within the area (8 second cooldown per target per cast instance). The meteor's damage and radius are increased based on your distance to the target at the time of the ability hit, increasing its damage by {{pp|0 to 230 for 11|600 to 3000|
augments.shortDescription: QUEST: Hit enemy champions with abilities from at least 600 units away 15 times. REWARD: Upon completion, hitting enemy champions from at least 600 units away fires a meteor at them.

augments.name: Get Excited
augments.description: Scoring a champion takedown grants you 100% bonus movement speed and 15% total attack speed for 4 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Increase Movement Speed and Attack Speed for 4 seconds on takedown.

augments.name: Growth Spurt
augments.description:
Replace a summoner spell with Growth Spurt.
20px|link= Growth Spurt: geteffect|Growth Spurt
augments.shortDescription: Gain Growth Spurt as a Summoner Spell. Growth Spurt suddenly increases your size, Knocking Up nearby enemies and granting max Health.

augments.name: Hide on Bush
augments.description: While in brush, you deal 20% increased damage. This effect lingers for 2 seconds after leaving brush.
augments.shortDescription: After entering Brush, deal 20% more damage for 2 seconds. Remain in the Brush to refresh the effect.

augments.name: Impassable
augments.description: Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment keystone runes.
augments.shortDescription: Gain the Aftershock and Glacial Augment Keystone Runes.

augments.name: It's Critical
augments.description: Grants 50% critical strike chance.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 50% Crit chance.

augments.name: It's Killing Time
augments.description: Upon casting your ultimate ability, you apply Death Mark|Zed to all enemy champions (8 second cooldown). The mark stores 40% of all post-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers damage you deal to the affected target, detonating after 5 seconds to deal true damage equal to the damage stored against them.
augments.shortDescription: After casting your Ultimate, mark all enemies and store up damage you deal to them. When it ends, detonate the damage.

augments.name: Lil' Extra Help
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has an effect which empowers your basic attacks for a duration, further enhancing the attacks by granting you 150|100 bonus attack range and  while the effect is active.
augments.shortDescription: Gain bonus Attack Range and Attack Speed during your chosen ability's duration.

augments.name: Magic Missile
augments.description: Dealing damage to an enemy champion with an ability fires 3 missiles at them that each deal true damage equal to % of the target's maximum health}}, increased to up to 1% based on distance travelled (maximum damage reached at 1000 units). This effect can only trigger once every 6 seconds from the same cast.
augments.shortDescription: Dealing Ability damage fires 3 missiles, each dealing percent max Health true damage based on distance traveled.

augments.name: Marksmage
augments.description: Basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 75% AP.
augments.shortDescription: Your Attacks deal additional physical damage equal to 75% Ability Power.

augments.name: Mercy's Strike
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to enhance your next basic attack. The enhanced attack has 300 bonus range, gains 75% bonus attack speed, and deals bonus magic damage equal to 3% (+ 2% per 10% heal and shield power) of the target's maximum health. If the target is a turret, the damage is modified to  bonus magic damage.
augments.shortDescription: After healing or shielding your ally with an ability, your next basic attack gains attack range, attack speed, and deals bonus max Health magic damage.

augments.name: Minionmancer
augments.description: Your pets deal 40% increased damage as well as gain 40% bonus health and size.
augments.shortDescription: Your summons gain 40% increased size, health, and damage.

augments.name: Nature is Healing
augments.description: Upon entering a patch of brush, you are healed for{{pp|40 to 300 (+ 15% of your missing health)|40/6 to 300/6 (+  every 0.25 seconds}}over 1.5 seconds (20 second cooldown per brush patch).
augments.shortDescription: Entering Brush regenerates a large amount of Health.

augments.name: Nightstalking
augments.description: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them renders you invisible for 1.5 seconds, during which you also gain 40% bonus movement speed. Attacking or casting abilites ends the stealth immediately.
augments.shortDescription: Takedowns against enemy champions within 3 seconds of damaging them grants you Movement Speed and renders you invisible.

augments.name: OK Boomerang
augments.description: Automatically cast an improved version of Boomerang Blade|Sivir at the closest nearby enemy champion within 1250 units, dealing 40 to 200 (+ 30% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) adaptive damage to enemies hit (10 second cooldown).
augments.shortDescription: Autocast throw a boomerang at a nearby enemy every 10 seconds.

augments.name: Our Healing
augments.description: Whenever a nearby unit is healed (excluding yourself), you heal yourself equal to 15% of the amount they healed, doubled to 30% from the heals of enemies.
augments.shortDescription: Whenever someone heals around you, you heal 15% of their own healing. Doubled from Enemy healing.

augments.name: Outlaw's Grit
augments.description: Dashing or blinking grants 12 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 15 seconds, stacking up to 5 times for a total of 60 bonus resistances, and refreshing on subsequent triggers.
augments.shortDescription: After using a Dash, Blink, or Teleport Ability you gain 12 Armor and Magic Resist up to 5 stacks.

augments.name: Overextender
augments.description:
Your launch with the Cannon Launcher is now empowered, increasing the launch range by 12,000 units and the impact damage by 50%, as well as the travel speed by a significant amount. Additionally, your Recall is now functional and is upgraded to Empowered Recall.
This augment is only available on the 20px|link= Butcher's Bridge map.
Total launch range is 18,500 units, reduced to 16,500 after your team's Outer turret is destroyed. Increased impact damage is .
augments.shortDescription: Recall to enter your Cannon Launcher. It has significantly increased range, travel speed, and damage.

augments.name: Overflow
augments.description: Your abilities' mana costs are doubled, but you also gain 10% (+ mana increased damage as well as self and outgoing healing and shielding.
augments.shortDescription: Your Mana costs are doubled. Your Ability Heals, Shields, and damage are increased based on your max Mana.

augments.name: Pat On The Back
augments.description: Whenever you are within 200 units of an allied champion, they pat you on the back, granting you a 50 to 150 (+ 25% bonus movement speed) shield and 30% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds (9 second cooldown). Subsequent passes only refresh the duration of the effects.
augments.shortDescription: Allies encourage you when you walk past, granting you a Shield and Movement Speed.

augments.name: Perseverance
augments.description:
Grants 1000% base health regeneration, increased to 2000% while below 25% maximum health.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Gain hugely increased Health Regen, further increased at low Health.

augments.name: Phenomenal Evil
augments.description:
Gain Phenomenal Evil Power|Veigar.
Phenomenal Evil Power: Generate a permanent stack of Phenomenal Evil each time you damage an enemy champion with ability damage. This effect cannot trigger more than once every second globally and once every 3 seconds from the same cast instance. For each stack, gain 1 ability power.
If this is not your first augment, start with 40 Phenomenal Evil stacks, granting you 40 ability power.
augments.shortDescription: Permanently gain 1 Ability Power when you damage enemy champions with Abilities. If taken as your second Augment, starts with 40 Ability Power.

augments.name: Pinball
augments.description:
Your Mark is empowered to instead throw a pinball, which deals  and ricochets off of terrain that it collides with. Each time the pinball ricochets, its remaining travel distance is reset, it increases in radius by 25%, deals 20% increased damage, and reduces Mark remaining cooldown by 30%. The pinball can ricochet up to 4 times, for a maximum radius increase of 100% and a damage increase of 80%. Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
augments.shortDescription: Your Snowball gains Ability Haste and deals extra True Damage. When the Snowball bounces off walls, it increases in size and damage and has a reduced Cooldown.

augments.name: Porcupine
augments.description: You build up a burst of needles from within you when taking damage from enemy champions, storing up to 400 to 3900 pre-mitigation damage|Damage calculated before modifiers taken. After reaching the maximum damage stored, you consume the stored damage to burst the needles outward in a 400 radius, dealing 75 to 200|(+ 125% bonus armor) (+ 125% bonus magic resistance) physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Taking damage from champions builds up a burst of needles that fly out of you, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

augments.name: Pressure Cooker
augments.description:
Surrounds you in flames, causing you to apply a Burn every second to enemy champions within 300 units for 3 seconds that deals magic damage equal to{{fd% of your maximum health per second.| over the duration.}}This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.
Additionally, you are assigned with quests that require you to deal a certain amount of damage with the Burn effect against enemy champions. There are three quest tiers, and each completed tier grants you a reward that improves Pressure Cooker's effect.
augments.shortDescription: Every second, apply a stacking Burn to nearby enemy champions, scaling with your max Health. QUEST: Deal Burn damage to enemy Champions. REWARD: Size and damage increase per Quest Level.

augments.name: Pursuit of Haste
augments.description: Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are two quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with ability haste on the ability.
augments.shortDescription: QUEST: Hit enemy champions with your chosen ability the required number of times.

augments.name: Pursuit of Power
augments.description:
Quest: Hit an enemy champion with a specific ability 10 times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance).
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the damage of the ability by 30%.
augments.shortDescription: QUEST: Hit an enemy champion with a specific ability 10 times. REWARD: Upon completing your Quest, increase the damage of the ability by 30%.

augments.name: Quest: Steel Your Heart
augments.description:
Quest: Obtain Heartsteel and accumulate over 300 bonus health from Colossal Consumption.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, increase the bonus health gained from Heartsteel Colossal Consumption by 200%.
augments.shortDescription: QUEST: Possess Heartsteel with 300+ stacks. REWARD: Multiply your Heartsteel stacks by 3.

augments.name: Quickstep
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to cause you to dash up to 350 units towards your cursor.
augments.shortDescription: When you use your chosen ability, dash towards your cursor.

augments.name: Ravenous Bind
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a immobilizing or grounding effect, empowering the ability to deal 15 to 90|(+ 10% AP) (+  magic damage to affected targets and heal you for 50 to 200 (+ 5% AP) (+ 10% bonus health). The heal is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is.
augments.shortDescription: Immobilizing or Grounding enemy champions with your ability deals extra damage and heals you.

augments.name: Recursion
augments.description: Grants 60 ability haste.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 60 Ability Haste.

augments.name: Rejuvenation
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to heal you for 30 to 100 (+ 25% bonus AD) (+ 15% AP) (+ 5% bonus health). This is increased by up to 50% based on how long the ability's cooldown is, for a maximum heal of 30*1.5 to 100*1.5 (+  (+  (+ .
augments.shortDescription: Using your ability restores Health.

augments.name: Reload
augments.description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, causing basic attacks on hit during the ability to reduce its remaining cooldown by 0.15 to 0.35 seconds.
This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Basic Attacks on-hit during your ability reduce its cooldown.

augments.name: Scopier Weapons
augments.description: Gain 200|100 bonus attack range.
augments.shortDescription: Gain bonus Attack Range, reduced for Ranged champions.

augments.name: Searing Dawn
augments.description:
Gain Sunlight|Leona.
Sunlight: Your damaging abilities mark enemies, causing them to take magic damage bonus magic damage from your ally's next basic attack or ability hit against them (0.75-second cooldown per target).
augments.shortDescription: Your Abilities mark enemies, causing them to take additional magic damage from your ally's next Attack or Ability.

augments.name: Shark Bait
augments.description:
Upon taking fatal damage, you become a Shark Bait, causing you to enter a zombie state for 3.5 seconds, during which your movement speed is set to a static 400, you gain ghosting, and enemies within 400 units of you are slowed by 40%. At the end of the duration, a massive shark emerges from beneath you that lets out a powerful chomp (400 radius), dealing 120 to 350|(+ 30% of target's missing health) magic damage to all enemies within the area and knocking them up for 1 second.
While under the zombie state, you are able to move and become invulnerable, untargetable, and immune to crowd control, but you are also rendered unable to declare basic attacks, cast abilities, use summoner spells, and activate items.
augments.shortDescription: A few seconds after death, a shark chomps all nearby enemies. You can move after death to aim the shark attack.

augments.name: Shark Tempest
augments.description:
Your Mark is empowered to circle sharks around it in a 300 radius, dealing  to enemies it passes through as it travels and slowing targets hit by 30% for 1 second. If the missile hits an enemy champion, the sharks circle around their location in a 425 radius instead for 3 seconds, dealing{{pp|25 to 75|(+ 20% bonus AD) (+ 12% AP) magic damage every second|25*3 to 75*3|(+ {{ap|20*3% bonus AD)}} (+  total magic damage over the duration}}to enemies within the area and slowing them by 30% for 3 seconds.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
augments.shortDescription: Sharks circle your Snowball, slowing and damaging nearby enemies. When your Snowball hits a Champion, they become trapped in a shark storm!

augments.name: Shrink Engine
augments.description:
Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, gain 8 ability haste and 1% bonus movement speed, and reduce your size by 4%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.
Size reduction is capped at 80% (20 stacks).
augments.shortDescription: Takedowns makes you smaller and grant Ability Haste and Movement Speed. Lose 65% stacks on death.

augments.name: Shrink Ray
augments.description: Basic attacks on hit reduce the target's damage dealt by 15% for 3 seconds, refreshing with each hit. Their size is also reduced significantly for the duration.
augments.shortDescription: Your Attacks reduce the target's damage and size by 15% On-Hit.

augments.name: Skilled Sniper
augments.description: Hitting an enemy champion with a basic ability while located at least er| 600 units away from them at the time of the hit reduces its current cooldown by 80% of its total cooldown, modified to 65% for damage over time abilities.
augments.shortDescription: Snipe an enemy with a non-Ultimate Ability refunds 80% Cooldown (65% for periodic Abilities).

augments.name: Snap Back
augments.description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability with a recast. Using the recast causes you to blink back to your original casting position of the ability and explode to deal 100 to 300|(+ 20% AD) (+ 20% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies.
This augment exists in the internal augment data but appears to be disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Recast your ability to explode and return to your original position.

augments.name: Snowball Upgrade
augments.description:
Your Mark is empowered to hail a snowstorm at the location where the target was hit for 2 seconds, granting sight of the area and dealing200 (+ 200% bonus AD) (+ 120% AP) magic damage|{{ap|magic damage (+  (+  magic damage every 0.25 seconds}}to enemies within over the duration, as well as slowing them by 50% (+ 6% per 100 AP). Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 50 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 50 Ability Haste on Snowball. Hitting an enemy creates a snowfall that deals AoE damage and Slows nearby enemies. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

augments.name: Snowblast
augments.description:
Empowers the Dash spell from Mark to deal 100% increased damage and upon arrival cause you to knock up the target for 0.5 seconds and knock back nearby enemies. Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
augments.shortDescription: Recasting Snowball deals increased damage, Knocks Up the target, and Knocks Back nearby enemies.

augments.name: Sonata
augments.description:
Alternate between automatically casting a modified version of Aria of Perseverance|Sona and modified Song of Celerity|Sona, with the former being cast first (10 second cooldown).
Aria of Perseverance: Heal yourself for 60 (+ 60% AP) and send out a tone to the most wounded|Based on greatest % missing health allied champion within 1000 units that heals them for the same amount. Additionally, generate an aura|400 unit radius, center-to-edge that grants you and tagged allied champions a 80 (+ 40% AP) shield for 1.5 seconds.
Song of Celerity: Gain 30% bonus movement speed for 7 seconds. If you take damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed. Additionally, generate an aura|400 unit radius, center-to-edge that grants tagged allied champions 20% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Every 10 seconds, automatically cast the Aria of Perseverence and Song of Celerity in an alternating melody. Aria of Perseverence heals nearby allies and grants a temporary shielding aura. Song of Celerity grants a temporary aura that provides bonus Movement Speed.

augments.name: Soul Eater
augments.description:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants you 20 bonus health, stacking infinitely (5 second cooldown per cast instance).
If this is not your first augment, gain 300 bonus health.
augments.shortDescription: Immobilizing an enemy champion grants 20 max Health. If taken as your second Augment, start with bonus Health.

augments.name: Soul Siphon
augments.description: Heal for 12% of the post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers dealt by your critical strikes. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.shortDescription: Heal for 12% of damage done by Critical Strikes. Gain 25% Crit chance.

augments.name: Spiritual Purification
augments.description: Scoring a champion takedown causes the area around the slain champion to explode in a 500 unit radius, dealing adaptive damage to enemies within equal to 15% of their current health and leaving behind a zone for 1.5 seconds that slows enemies within by 60%.
augments.shortDescription: On takedown, creates an explosion that slows other nearby enemies by 60%, and deals damage based on their current Health.

augments.name: Stats on Stats!
augments.description: Gain 3 Stat Bonus|Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of obtaining Gold- and Prismatic-tier anvils.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 3 Stat Anvils, with a higher chance of Gold and Prismatic Anvils!

augments.name: Tank Engine
augments.description: Scoring a champion takedown generates a stack, stacking infinitely. For each stack, increase your maximum health and size by 5%. Lose 65% of stacks on death.
augments.shortDescription: On takedown, gain a stack that increases your size and max Health. Lose stacks on death.

augments.name: Terrain'd
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that spawns terrain, empowering the ability to deal 20 to 180|(+ 20% AP) magic damage to enemies near the terrain. This damage is increasedby 200%|to {{pp|20*3 to 180*3|(+ {{ap|20*3% AP)}}}}if the ability is an ultimate.
augments.shortDescription: Your terrain ability deals damage in an area around it.

augments.name: Thread the Needle
augments.description: Grants 18% armor penetration and magic penetration.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 18% Armor Penetration and Magic Penetration.

augments.name: Tooth Fairy
augments.description: When you deal damage to an enemy champion equal to or more than 25% of their maximum health within 2.5 seconds, they drop a Tooth on the ground (4 second cooldown per target). You can pick up this Tooth by moving over it, granting you a Dental Records stack. For each stack, you gain 3 lethality and flat magic penetration.
augments.shortDescription: Bursting enemies drops Teeth. Picking up Teeth grants you permanent Lethality and Magic Penetration.

augments.name: Transmute: Prismatic
augments.description: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment.
augments.shortDescription: Gain a random Prismatic Augment.

augments.name: Upgrade Infinity Edge
augments.description:
Upgrades Infinity Edge, empowering it to gain Sword of the Divine Excoriate. Additionally, gain 500.
Excoriate: Gain a random amount of bonus critical strike damage that scales up to 50% of your critical strike chance, with the value of this amount changing every 0.25 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 500 Gold. Having Infinity Edge allows your Critical Strike Chance to grant random Critical Strike Damage each Attack.

augments.name: Upgrade Ravenous Hydra
augments.description: Upgrades Ravenous Hydra, increasing its life steal stat to 20% and empowering Cleave to trigger its effect on ability hits against enemies (1 second cooldown per ability). Additionally, gain 500.
augments.shortDescription: Upgrades Ravenous Hydra, increasing its Life Steal stat to 20% and empowering Cleave to trigger on ability hits against enemies. Additionally, gain 500 Gold.

augments.name: Upgrade Sheen
augments.description: Upgrades all Spellblade items, empowering the passive effect to deal additional bonus physical damage equal to 4% of the target's maximum health and heal you for . Additionally, gain 250.
augments.shortDescription: Your Spellblade effects deal additional damage and heal you for a percent of the target's health. Additionally, gain 250 Gold.

augments.name: Upgrade Sundered Sky
augments.description: Upgrades Sundered Sky, empowering Lightshield Strike with an increased heal health ratio of 9% of your missing health and a reduced cooldown of 5 seconds. Additionally, gain 500.
augments.shortDescription: Reduce Sundered Sky's per-target cooldown to 5 seconds and heal for 9% of missing Health. Gain 500 Gold.

augments.name: Vampirism
augments.description:
You can no longer be healed by allies and your health regeneration is set to 0. Gain 25% omnivamp.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: You cannot be healed by allies or gain Health Regen. Gain 25% Omnivamp.

augments.name: Void Dash
augments.description:
Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a dash, empowering the ability to spawn a void zone (250 radius) at the dash's destination after a 0.3-second delay. Enemy champions within the zone are dealt 80 to 400|(+ 100% ability haste) magic damage and are slowed by 35% for 1 second.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Dashing with your ability spawns a Void Zone that Slows enemy champions and deals magic damage.

augments.name: Vulnerability
augments.description:
Damage dealt by items and damage over time effects can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical damage) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
If both 20px|link=|An icon for the ARAM: Mayhem augment Jeweled Gauntlet Jeweled Gauntlet and Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).
augments.shortDescription: Your Item and damage over time effects can Critically Strike. Gain 25% Crit chance.

augments.name: Warlock Juicebox
augments.description: Gain 10% (+ 3% per 100 AP) omnivamp.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 10% (+ 3% per 100 Ability Power) Omnivamp.

augments.name: Wee Woo Wee Woo
augments.description: Gain {{pp| lingering for 2 seconds after no longer facing them. Your heals and shields are also increased by {{pp|
augments.shortDescription: When moving towards allies with low Health, gain Movement Speed. Your Healing and Shielding are greater based on how low your target's Health is.

augments.name: With Haste
augments.description: Grants bonus movement speed equal to 70% ability haste.
augments.shortDescription: Gain Move Speed equal to 70% of your Ability Haste.

augments.name: Yowch, My Coins!
augments.description: Enemy champions that you score a takedown against drop 6 to 10 coins, with each coin landing 500 units away from the location of their death and lasting 10 seconds. You or allied champions can collect the coins by moving over them, granting 15 for each coin collected.
augments.shortDescription: On takedown, enemy champions drop coins nearby, which you and your allies can collect. Each is worth 15 gold.

augments.name: Archmage
augments.description: Whenever you cast an ability, refund the cooldown of another, randomly selected ability by 30% of the casted ability's cooldown.
augments.shortDescription: Casting a spell refunds another random spell's cost by 30% of the original spell's Cooldown.

augments.name: Back to Basics
augments.description: Your champion abilities deal 35% increased damage and you gain 70 ability haste and 35% increased healing and shielding from all sources, but your ultimate ability is permanently sealed.
augments.shortDescription: Gain increased Ability Damage, Healing, Shielding, and Ability Haste, but you cannot use your Ultimate Ability.

augments.name: Biggest Snowball Ever
augments.description:
Upgrades your Mark into a massive snowball, empowering it with an increased size radius and the ability to pass through non-champions. The snowball additionally explodes upon impact of the target hit to deal magic damage (+ 100% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to all nearby enemies, knock them up for 0.75 seconds, and slow them by 20% for 2 seconds. Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark. Non-champions hit by the snowball are stunned for 1.25 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball. Your snowball is BIG and will pass through minions. It Slows, Knocks Up champions, and deals additional damage. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

augments.name: Blade Waltz
augments.description:
Replace a summoner spell with 20px|link= Blade Waltz.
Blade Waltz: Blink to the target enemy champion. You then blink to the nearest other enemy champion every 0.25 seconds over the next 1.75 seconds, blinking up to 7 additional times. The last blink targets the primary target. Each time you blink to an enemy, deal physical damage (+ 10% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) physical damage to them and apply on-hit effects at 50% effectiveness, up to a total of physical damage (+  (+  (45 second cooldown).
While Blade Waltz is active, you are untargetable and unable to act. This effect will end prematurely if there are no longer any nearby valid targets to blink to. An enemy can be blinked to more than once if there are no other valid targets in range.
augments.shortDescription: Gain Blade Waltz as a Summoner Spell.

augments.name: Can't Touch This
augments.description: Casting your ultimate grants you invulnerability for 2 seconds (8 second cooldown).
augments.shortDescription: Casting your Ultimate makes you Invulnerable for a short duration.

augments.name: Circle of Death
augments.description: Healing and health regeneration you do causes you to deal 70% of that value in magic damage to the nearest enemy champion within 1000 units.
augments.shortDescription: Healing and Health Regen also deals magic damage to the nearest enemy champion.

augments.name: Clown College
augments.description:
Gain Shaco Backstab|Shaco, Deceive|Shaco and Hallucinate|Shaco explosion. Replace a summoner spell with Deceive|Shaco.
20px|link= Passive - Backstab: Your basic attacks deal physical damage (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 35% AP) bonus physical damage|physical on-hit when hitting an enemy from behind.
20px|link= Active - Deceive: Become invisible for up to 3 seconds and blink to the target location within 400 units after a 0.125-second delay. Your next basic attack while in stealth deals 100 (+ 150% bonus AD) (+ 55% AP) bonus physical damage, increased to{{ap|physical damage (+  (+  bonus physical damage|155% damage}}if 20px|link= Backstab was applied (45 second cooldown).
20px|link= Passive - Hallucinate Death: Upon your death, release an explosion in a cr| 350 radius of your death location, dealing true damage equal to 25% of target's maximum health to enemies within the area. Additionally, you deploy a Jack in the Box|Shaco|box at the location of your death that instantly fears nearby enemies for 1 second. This box does not attack but lasts for 3 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Gain Deceive Summoner Spell. Gain Backstab Passive. When you die, spawn an exploding box that deals a large amount of true damage and Fear nearby enemies.

augments.name: Courage of the Colossus
augments.description: Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion grants a shield for 3 seconds that absorbs 150 to 450 (+ 4% maximum health) damage (5 second cooldown per cast instance). Shields can stack between multiple triggers of this effect, though not refreshing the duration of previous shields.
augments.shortDescription: Gain a 150 to 450 (+ 4% maximum Health) Shield after Immobilizing or Grounding an enemy champion.

augments.name: Cruelty
augments.description:
Immobilizing or grounding an enemy champion summons a comet above them that lands at their current location after 1 second, dealing magic damage (+ 40% AP) (+ 4% of your maximum health) magic damage to enemies within a 300 radius (6 second cooldown per cast instance).
For displacement effects, the comet will be summoned at the displacement's end location.
augments.shortDescription: On Immobilizing or Grounding a champion, summon a comet that lands after a delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies.

augments.name: Dashing
augments.description: Abilities with dashes or blinks gain 175 ability haste.
augments.shortDescription: Your dash, leap, blink, or teleport Abilities gain 175 Ability Haste.

augments.name: Devil on Your Shoulder
augments.description:
Forge a pact with Teemo|Little Devil, who drains  every second, increased to 5% if there are enemy champions within 1000 units. In return, you deal 20% bonus true damage and your basic attacks and abilities summon a Life Remnant nearby for 5 seconds (0.75-second spawn cooldown). You can absorb a Life Remnant by moving over it, healing you for 50 to 150 (+ 50% bonus AD) (+ 25% AP) and granting you 15% bonus movement speed.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Forge a pact with The Little Devil himself. He drains your life over time but rewards by applying bonus true damage against champions and creating healing remnants for you to acquire.

augments.name: Dimension Shift
augments.description:
Replace a summoner spell with When the Darkness Comes.
20px|link= When the Darkness Comes: geteffect|When the Darkness Comes
The Dark Realm is a battlefield that exists outside of the normal realm in an alternate dimension. It exists only for units hit by the cosmic light. The realm includes any terrain features that would exist in the map of the normal realm, including structures, walls, and brushes.
Units between realms see each other as glowing stars, considering each other dead and negating any interactions between each other. Only units that were hit by the light will enter the realm; other units cannot follow them. Everything that occurs inside the Dark Realm is hidden to units outside of it, and vice versa.
Structures exist in all realms at the same time, but champions in the Dark Realm can only deal 1 damage to them per damage instance. Turrets will behave normally as if all units were in the same realm. Pets still inside the Dark Realm are killed at its end.
augments.shortDescription: Gain the When the Darkness Comes Summoner Spell. Create a zone that transports everyone inside of it to another dimension.

augments.name: Double Tap
augments.description: Basic attacks that critically strike apply on hit effects an additional time. Additionally, gain 25% critical strike chance.
augments.shortDescription: Your Critical Strikes apply On-Hit effects an additional time. Gain 25% Crit Chance.

augments.name: Draw Your Sword
augments.description: Become melee, modifying your attack range to 200 (+ 100% bonus attack range from augments) units. Additionally, gain 24% bonus attack damage, 20% bonus attack speed, 24% bonus health, 20% bonus movement speed, and 20% life steal. These bonuses are increased by {{pp|
augments.shortDescription: Become melee and gain Attack Damage, Health, Attack Speed, Lifesteal, and Movement Speed (scaling with the range you give up).

augments.name: DropBear
augments.description:
Upon death, you summon Tibbers who drops from above and lands onto the location of your death over 0.5 seconds. Upon landing, he deals 250 to 750|(+ 100% AP) (+ 2 per 1 flat magic penetration) (+ 5 per 1% magic penetration) magic damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 1.5 seconds. Tibbers then chases after and targets the enemy champion that killed you, attacking them once he is in range.
Tibbers has all of your augments (excluding DropBear) and lasts for up to 8 to 20 seconds. He gains {{as|{{pp|80 to 100|
augments.shortDescription: On death, a giant Tibbers with all your augments falls from the sky and damages nearby enemies.

augments.name: Dropkick
augments.description:
Your basic attacks and abilities execute enemy champions below 4% (+  (+ 1% per 1000 bonus health) of their maximum health, which causes their corpse to be sent flying away in a line. Upon collision with an enemy champion or terrain, the target's corpse explodes to deal magic damage (+ 100% bonus armor) (+ 100% bonus magic resistance) magic damage to nearby enemies. Successful executions heal you for 100 to 300 (+ 25% bonus health).
The execution may also be triggered by the explosion and ignores shields.
augments.shortDescription: Your Attacks and Abilities execute low Health enemy champions, Knocking Back and causing an explosion while healing you.

augments.name: Droppybara
augments.description:
Replace a summoner spell with Droppybara.
20px|link= Droppybara: geteffect|Droppybara
This augment is only offered to up to 1 player on each team for a given game.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Gain Droppybara as a Summoner Spell. After a delay, call down a capybara that deals 25% max Health true damage.

augments.name: Dual Wield
augments.description: Your basic attacks launch a bolt at the target that fires after a 0.225-second delay|Estimated on attack, deals 40% of the triggering attack's pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers damage, and applies on hit effects at 40% effectiveness. Additionally, increase your total attack speed by 10%.
augments.shortDescription: Attacks fire a bolt that applies On-Hit effects at reduced strength. Gain 10% total Attack Speed.

augments.name: Earthwake
augments.description:
Dashing or blinking causes you to leave behind a trail cr| from the location you moved to your destination that detonates after 0.75 seconds in a 300 radius, dealing physical damage (+ 125% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP) physical damage per explosion to enemies hit, reduced to 70% against minions. Enemies can be affected only once every second from all cast instances, and the effect is not triggered if you move beyond 2000 units with the dash or blink.
This augment is only offered to up to 2 players on each team for a given game.
augments.shortDescription: Your dash, blink, or teleport Abilities leave behind a trail that detonates after 0.75 second.

augments.name: Echo Cast
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability's cast to summon a clone of your champion that is untargetable and moves up to 500 units towards your cursor. The clone then casts the ability it was summoned from after a 0.25-second delay, mimicking the active effects of the casted spell and disappearing after it finishes casting.
augments.shortDescription: Casting your ability sends a clone toward your mouse position and recasts it.

augments.name: Empowered By The Faithful
augments.description: Granting a heal or shield to an allied champion blesses them for 8 seconds. Whenever a blessed ally damages an enemy champion, you generate a stack of Devotion, stacking up to 50 times. Upon reaching maximum stacks, you unleash a shockwave that deals magic damage (+ 750% heal and shield power) magic damage to nearby enemies. Enemy champions damaged below a percentage of their maximum health equal to 25% of your heal and shield power are executed.
augments.shortDescription: Healing or Shielding allies blesses them, causing their damage to fill you with devotion. When you have enough devotion, unleash a shockwave dealing magic damage and executes low health enemies.

augments.name: Empyrean Promise
augments.description:
Replace a summoner spell with Empyrean Promise Vigilance active. Additionally, gain 15% heal and shield power.
Active - Vigilance: After a 0.25-second delay, dash to the current location of the target allied champion and gain a 100 to 250 (+ 100% AP) (+ 10% bonus health) shield for 3 seconds. Upon arrival, grant the ally the same shield (20 second cooldown; 2000 range).
augments.shortDescription: Gain 15% Heal and Shield power. Gain Empyrean Promise as a Summoner Spell. Vigilance: Teleport to an ally and grant a Shield for 3 seconds after landing.

augments.name: En Passant
augments.description:
You can now identify the Vitals of enemy champions within 2000 units|Estimated, marked as an arc around them and pointing towards a specific direction. Dealing damage to a target with a basic attack or ability while you are facing in the direction of their exposed Vital will consume it, dealing bonus true damage equal to 6% (+ buzzword7 of the target's maximum health, healing you for 50 to 200 (+ 5% missing health), and granting you 50% (+ 5% per En Passant stack) bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. Consuming a target's Vital also grants you an En Passant stack for 8 seconds, refreshing on subsequent Vital triggers and stacking up a number of times. Each En Passant stack increases the consumed Vital damage and bonus movement speed.
Vitals on targets become exposed instantly once you are within range and remain exposed until you die. Once a target's Vital is consumed, you identify a new Vital on them pointing in a different direction from the previous after 4 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Periodically identify Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting them with Attacks or Abilities deals max Health true damage, restores Health, and grants Movement Speed. These effects can stack.

augments.name: Eureka
augments.description: Gain ability haste equal to 30% AP.
augments.shortDescription: Gain Ability Haste equal to 30% Ability Power.

augments.name: Fan the Hammer
augments.description: Your next basic attack against an enemy champion in each cardinal direction within attack range|750 range additionally on-attack fires 5 missiles at the target that each deal physical damage (+ 14% bonus AD) physical damage, for a total of physical damage (+  physical damage (5 second cooldown per direction). Missiles' damage is increased by {{pp|
augments.shortDescription: Attacks against enemy champions fire 5 missiles that deal more damage with distance. Each direction has its own Cooldown.

augments.name: Fey Magic
augments.description: Damaging enemies with your ultimate ability polymorphs them into harmless critters for 2 seconds, during which their base movement speed is reduced by 60, and disarms them for the same duration (15 second cooldown per target).
augments.shortDescription: Damaging with your Ultimate Polymorphs enemies for a few seconds.

augments.name: Final Form
augments.description: Casting your ultimate ability empowers you for 10 seconds, causing you to gain a shield for 50% of your maximum health, 20% omnivamp, and 30% bonus movement speed for the duration (20 second cooldown).
augments.shortDescription: After casting your Ultimate, gain a max Health Shield, Omnivamp and Movement Speed for 10 seconds.

augments.name: Giant Slayer
augments.description: Become tiny, reducing your size by 75% and granting you 20% bonus movement speed. Additionally, deal {{pp|
augments.shortDescription: Become tiny, gain Movement Speed, and gain bonus damage to champions based on how much larger they are than you.

augments.name: Glass Cannon
augments.description: You gain a health threshold equal to 70% maximum health which cannot be modified|By increases or decreases to maximum health nor exceeded|By healing and health regeneration by any means. In return, you deal bonus true damage equal to 25%|15% of all of the damage you deal pre-mitigation|Damage calculated before modifiers.
augments.shortDescription: Reduce max Health by 30%. Deal bonus true damage based on the damage you deal.

augments.name: Goldrend
augments.description: Damaging basic attacks or abilities against enemy champions deal magic damage (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP) bonus magic damage, and grant you 30 and 25% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds (30 second cooldown per champion).
augments.shortDescription: Damaging a champion with Attacks or Abilities deals additional magic damage, and grants you Gold and Movement Speed.

augments.name: Goliath
augments.description: Grants 35% bonus health, 15% adaptive force, and 50% increased size.
augments.shortDescription: Become large, gaining 35% Health and 15% Adaptive Force.

augments.name: Hand of Baron
augments.description: Gain a modified Hand of Baron, which only grants 25% increased adaptive force and greatly empowers nearby allied minions.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 25% Adaptive Force. Nearby allied minions are greatly empowered.

augments.name: Hellbent
augments.description:
Generate a stack of Revivemaxxing for each enemy champion you hit with basic attacks or abilities, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 10 times. At maximum stacks, you become Hellbent.
 Upon taking lethal damage, you enter resurrection for 4 seconds, during which you are invulnerable, untargetable, and unable to act. Afterwards, you revive with  or  (Adaptive), {{as|{{pp|20 to 40| and {{as|{{pp|15 to 30|
augments.shortDescription: Damaging enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants stacks. At max stacks, you revive empowered upon death.

augments.name: High Roller
augments.description: Nearby enemies that die have a 1.5% chance to drop a Stat Bonus|Stat Anvil at the location of their death. You can pick up dropped anvils by moving over them. The obtained Stat Bonus|Stat Anvils will be consumed once the shop is enabled again (after your death).
augments.shortDescription: Nearby enemies have a chance to drop Stat Anvils on death.

augments.name: Holy Snowball
augments.description:
After using the Dash spell from Mark, you become invulnerable for 1.5 seconds upon arrival. Additionally, your Mark cooldown is reduced equivalent to 100 ability haste.
If Mark is not equipped, you will be prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with Mark.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 100 Ability Haste on Snowball. You are briefly Invulnerable when you dash with Snowball. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.

augments.name: Infernal Conduit
augments.description:
Your ability hits against champions apply a Burn for 3 seconds that deals{{pp|6/3 to 60/3|(+ 4.{{recurring% bonus AD)}} (+  bonus magic damage per second|6 to 60|(+ 14% bonus AD) (+ 6% AP) bonus magic damage over the duration}}(1 second cooldown per cast instance). This Burn stacks infinitely and refreshes with each application.
Additionally, all of your Burn effects reduce the cooldowns of all your basic abilities by 0.08 seconds for each tick of damage they deal to a target.
augments.shortDescription: Your Abilities apply stacking Burn that deals damage over time. Your Burn effects reduce your basic Ability Cooldowns.

augments.name: Infinite Recursion
augments.description: Gain 60 ability haste, increased by 3 each time you score a champion takedown.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 60 Ability Haste, plus 3 Ability Haste per takedown.

augments.name: Jeweled Gauntlet
augments.description:
Your abilities can now critically strike for (145% + bonus critical damage) damage. Additionally, gain 25% (+  critical strike chance.
If both Jeweled Gauntlet and 20px|link=|An icon for the ARAM: Mayhem augment Vulnerability Vulnerability are equipped, only rolls the critical strike chance of the augment that has the higher critical damage (or either if equal).
augments.shortDescription: Your Abilities can Critically Strike. Gain 25% Crit Chance.

augments.name: King Me
augments.description:
Upon entering the enemy team's gate or Catapult for the first time, either of which are located near their spawn, you become 20px|link= Kinged, causing you to gain one random Prismatic-tier augment and the first eligible Legendary item in your inventory to be upgraded with improved stats. The gold value of all upgradeable stats|Includes AH, AP, AD, AS, AR, MR, and HP on the item is increased by exactly 1000.
King Me prioritize upgrading the first Legendary item eligible for a upgrade based on its position in the inventory, detecting each slot until an eligible item is found.
augments.shortDescription: The first time you take the enemy transport with a Legendary Item you become Kinged, upgrading your item and gaining a random Prismatic Augment.

augments.name: Mad Scientist
augments.description: Upon acquiring this augment and each time you respawn, gain either 30% adaptive force, 20% bonus health, and 40% increased size or 70 ability haste, 40% bonus movement speed, and 40% reduced size.
augments.shortDescription: On each Revive, you grow large (gaining Adaptive Force and Health) or tiny (gaining Ability Haste and Movement Speed).

augments.name: Master of Duality
augments.description: Basic attacks on hit grant  and damaging abilities once per cast instance grant , lasting for 5 seconds, with the duration of both refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking infinitely.
augments.shortDescription: Your Attacks grant you stacking Ability Power and your Abilities that damage enemies grant you Attack Damage.

augments.name: Multishot
augments.description:
Assigns quests that require you to hit enemy champions with a specific ability's missile a number of times (counts up to 1 hit per champion per cast instance). There are six quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional missile fired on the ability's cast. The reward effect also modifies the ability to fire all of its missiles in a cone. Subsequent missile hits from the same cast against the same enemy deal 30% damage.
Hit requirements as denoted below are rounded down to whole numbers, with a minimum value of 1.
augments.shortDescription: QUEST: Hit enemy champions with your chosen ability the required number of times. REWARD: Fire additional missiles per Quest Level.

augments.name: Mystic Punch
augments.description: Basic attacks on hit reduce the remaining cooldowns of your abilities by 1.25 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: On-Hit reduce the cooldown of your abilities by 1.25 seconds .

augments.name: Ominous Pact
augments.description: Your abilities now have a health cost of 5% current health to cast them. In return, you gain ability power based on your missing health, up to AP at 70% missing health,  capped at 70% missing health bonus movement speed, and  capped at 70% missing health omnivamp.
augments.shortDescription: Gain Ability Power, Movement Speed, and Omnivamp based on missing Health, taking damage each time you cast.

augments.name: Omni Soul
augments.description: Grants 3 random Dragon Soul|Dragon Souls.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 3 random Dragon Souls.

augments.name: Overloaded
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities, empowering the ability to have its cooldown reset whenever you cast a different ability.
augments.shortDescription: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of your chosen ability.

augments.name: Pandora's Box
augments.description: Gain one random Prismatic-tier augment. Additionally, your current augments transform into an equal number of completely random Prismatic-tier ones.
augments.shortDescription: Transmute all of your augments into random Prismatic Augments.

augments.name: Pin Cushion
augments.description: Upgrades one of your champion's abilities that has a duration-based effect, empowering it to cause basic attacks during the ability's effect to apply Nail stacks against enemy champions. At the end of the ability's duration, or if you die, the stacks on all targets are consumed, dealing 20 to 60|physical damage per Nail stack on the target. If this effect would deal lethal damage to the target, the stacks are consumed immediately. Additionally, once a target's stacks are consumed, you gain 10 bonus movement speed per consumed stack for 3 seconds.
augments.shortDescription: Attacks during your chosen ability gouge your target with Nails. Nails accumulate damage, execute, and grant Movement Speed upon expiration.

augments.name: Poro Stampede
augments.description:
20px|link= Poro-Snaxes will now randomly appear around you every 25 to 15 seconds. You can pick up a Poro-Snax by moving over it, granting you a Poro-Snax charge. Poro-Snaxes will not spawn while you are at the maximum number of Poro-Snax charges (2). Feeding a 20px|link= Poro with a Poro-Snax generates a stack of 20px|link= Poro Love. At 5 stacks, you are granted the Poro Charge summoner spell and are prompted to replace one of your summoner spells with it. You are then assigned with quests that require you to reach a certain amount of 20px|link= Poro Love stacks. There are nine quest tiers, and each completed tier rewards you with an additional Poro wave for Poro Charge.
20px|link= Poro Charge: geteffect|Poro Charge
augments.shortDescription: QUEST: Gather Poro Snax and feed Poros. REWARD: Gain the Poro Charge Summoner Spell, which launches waves of Poros at the enemy team. Additional waves unlock per Quest Level.

augments.name: Prom Queen
augments.description:
Automatically cast a modified version of The Quickness|Rakan, empowering you to break into a captivating sprint for 6 seconds. While empowered, you gain ghosting and 50% bonus movement speed, and enemies you collide with|300 unit collision radius are knocked down and become charmed for 1.5 seconds (35 second cooldown).
A sparkly tiara will descend upon you 2.5 seconds before the effect activates.
augments.shortDescription: Every 35 seconds, Autocast a sparkly tiara descends upon you. When it lands, gain Rakan's Ultimate, charming enemies you touch.

augments.name: Protein Shake
augments.description: Gain 25% (+ 35% per 100 bonus armor) (+ 35% per 100 bonus magic resistance) heal and shield power.
augments.shortDescription: Gain 25% (+ 35% per 100 bonus Armor) (+ 35% per 100 bonus Magic Resist) Heal and Shield Power.

augments.name: Quantum Computing
augments.description:
Automatically cast an improved version of Tactical Sweep|Camille when an enemy champion is within 650 units of you, winding up over 0.75 seconds to slash in a 650 radius around you. The slash deals physical damage (+ 75% bonus AD) (+ 45% AP) physical damage to enemies within the area (30 second cooldown). Enemies hit by the outer edge of the circle take bonus physical damage equal to 10% (+  (+  (+  of their maximum health and are slowed by 80% decaying over 2 seconds. Additionally, you are healed for 80% of the bonus post-mitigation|Damage calculated after modifiers damage against enemy champions hit by the outer edge.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Periodically Autocast a massive slash. Enemies hit are Slowed, take additional max Health damage, and heal you.

augments.name: Quest: Icathia's Fall
augments.description:
Gain Bami's Cinder. You can now purchase Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis in spite of the item limit imposed by Immolate.
Quest: Obtain Hollow Radiance and Sunfire Aegis.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Void Immolation.
augments.shortDescription: Immediately: Gain a Bami's Cinder. QUEST: Possess Sunfire Aegis and Hollow Radiance. REWARD: These Items combine into Void Immolation.

augments.name: Quest: Sneakerhead
augments.description:
Assigns quests that require you to perform specific tasks while equipped with a particular [https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Category:Boots_items Boots item], which is granted to you for free during its respective quest. Finish the following quests, which are assigned to you in a random order:
Quest - {{ii|Berserker's Greaves:}} Basic attack 25 times.Quest - {{ii|Boots of Swiftness:}} Run 300 steps.Quest - {{ii|Ionian Boots of Lucidity:}} Cast 20 abilities.Quest - {{ii|Mercury's Treads:}} Become afflicted by crowd control 5 times.Quest - {{ii|Plated Steelcaps:}} Reduce a total of 200 damage with Plating.Quest - {{ii|Sorcerer's Shoes:}} Deal a total of 1500 damage with abilities.
Reward: Upon completing all of the above quests, you receive Jarvan I's.
You cannot purchase any Boots items while equipped with this augment. If you already have a Boots item, it is replaced by the Boots granted by this effect. Boots items gained from this effect cannot be sold.
This augment is currently disabled.
augments.shortDescription: Immediate: Gain a random pair of upgraded boots. Requirement: Complete its quest to swap for another. Reward: Jarvan I's Boot

augments.name: Quest: Urf's Champion
augments.description:
Quest: Score 18 champion takedowns.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, you receive The Golden Spatula.
If your inventory is full at the time of quest completion, the item will be granted as soon as a slot in the inventory is available.
augments.shortDescription: QUEST: Score takedowns. REWARD: Golden Spatula.

augments.name: Quest: Wooglet's Witchcap
augments.description:
Gain a Needlessly Large Rod.
Quest: Obtain Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass.
Reward: Upon completing your Quest, convert the items you obtained for the quest into Wooglet's Witchcap.
augments.shortDescription: Immediately gain a Needlessly Large Rod. QUEST: Possess Rabadon's Deathcap and Zhonya's Hourglass. REWARD: Gain Wooglet's Witchcap.

augments.name: Rite of Ascension
augments.description: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them causes them to leave behind their Essence for 8 seconds.
